description: Documented exclusions for scripts/check_sdk_coverage.py (issue #556). Each entry states why one operationId is intentionally absent from one SDK surface. POLICY: an exemption must record a genuinely intentional architectural reason - one of: (1) admin-only operator surface that is not part of the user-facing SDK scope; (2) v2 alias of a covered v1 operation (the SDK exposes only the canonical v1 implementation); (3) non-JSON/binary or non-REST transport (CSV/Parquet/SVG/Prometheus/GraphQL/WebSocket/SSE/webhook receivers) that the SDK's JSON transports cannot parse; (4) ops/DLQ or one-click email flows meant for internal tooling or browsers, not SDK callers. Exemptions that merely acknowledge a missing implementation ('known gap', 'not yet wired', 'to be added later') are FORBIDDEN - implement the operation instead. The CI gate also fails when an allowlisted operation becomes implemented (stale entry) or when an entry references an unknown operationId. Every entry carries a human-written reason; adding one is a deliberate act, never automatic.
note_go_client: packages/go-client is regenerated from docs/openapi.yaml and pinned by the go-client-stale CI job, so name coverage there is already enforced.
